title.narrative: Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) Teachers for the Future Program

description.narrative: The TVET Teachers for Future (TTF) program will support the Government of Bangladesh's Integrated TVET Development Action Plan (ITDAP), as envisaged in the Bangladesh Vision 2041 (Vision '41), the Perspective Plan of Bangladesh, 2021-2041 (PP2041) and the Eighth Five Year Plan, to improve equitable availability of qualified TVET teachers, especially outside of Dhaka. The TTF program aims to (i) expand inclusive provision of modern TVET teacher training; (ii) strengthen pedagogical and technical skills of TVET teachers and educators in modern and emerging technologies; and (iii) improve TVET teacher development, management, and reporting system. The program will benefit at least 10,000 new and existing TVET teachers within the program period and establish a system for continuous professional development that will substantially improve the quality and relevance of TVET in Bangladesh.
